  --vp-cat-clr:#f97316;
  --vp-cat-clr-soft:#f9731622;
  --vp-tag-clr:#8b5cf6;
  --vp-tag-clr-soft:#8b5cf61a;
  --vp-search-clr:#f97316;
  --vp-search-clr-soft:#f9731614;
}

/* === 1. LATEST VIDEOS filter pills → 5% rounded rect === */
.vp-home-tab{border-radius:6px !important}
.vp-home-tab__count{border-radius:4px !important}

/* === 2. Search results in a 5% rounded rectangle box === */
.vp-search-results-box{
  border:2px solid var(--vp-search-clr);
  border-radius:6px;
  background:var(--vp-search-clr-soft);
  padding:var(--md);
  margin-bottom:var(--md);
  box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.18),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.04);
}
.vp-search-results-box .vp-search-hd{
  padding:0 0 var(--sm);
  margin-bottom:var(--md);
  border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--vp-search-clr);
}
.vp-search-results-box .vp-search-q{color:var(--vp-search-clr)}

/* === 3. Categories → 5% rounded rect, admin-customisable colour === */
.vp-card__cat,
.vp-single-cat-badge{
  background:var(--vp-cat-clr) !important;
  border-radius:6px !important;
  color:#fff !important;
}
/* Sidebar category list — turn the count chip into a 5% rect using the colour */
.vp-sb-cat__cnt{
  border-radius:6px !important;
  border-color:var(--vp-cat-clr) !important;
}
.vp-sb-cat:hover .vp-sb-cat__cnt{
  background:var(--vp-cat-clr) !important;
  border-color:var(--vp-cat-clr) !important;
}
/* Sidebar "Categories" widget border accent uses the same colour */
.vp-sidebar .vp-widget:nth-of-type(n+3){border-color:var(--vp-cat-clr)}

/* === 4. Tags → 5% rounded rect, admin-customisable colour === */
.vp-tag{
  border-radius:6px !important;
  border-color:var(--vp-tag-clr) !important;
  color:var(--vp-tag-clr) !important;
  background:var(--vp-tag-clr-soft) !important;
}
.vp-tag:hover{
  background:var(--vp-tag-clr) !important;
  color:#fff !important;
  border-color:var(--vp-tag-clr) !important;
}
/* "Sidebar Tags" tab content uses the same .vp-tag rule above */

/* === 5. Pagination → footer gap = 1px === */
.vp-pagi-wrap{
  padding:var(--md) 0 0 !important;
  margin-bottom:0 !important;
}
.vp-pagi-wrap + .vp-footer,
.vp-footer{margin-top:1px !important}

/* === 6 + 7. Mobile single-post flow ===
   Reorder content on mobile only. RU widget shows inline at the end of the
   post via .vp-section-ru. Related posts move below it (capped at 2 by the
   existing nth-child rule). Comments are last. */
@media (max-width:768px){
  .vp-single-main{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
  /* Default order for direct children is 0 — they render in source order. */
  /* Push three sections to the very end in the requested sequence. */
  .vp-single-main > .vp-section-ru{order:10}
  .vp-single-main > .vp-section-related{order:11}
  .vp-single-main > .vp-section-comments{order:12}
}
/* The vp-widget--mobile-only class (defined earlier in the theme) handles
   hiding the inline RU on desktop, where the sidebar RU widget takes over. */

/* === 8. VP_Recent_Posts_Widget — between-posts ad block === */
.vp-sb-inline-ad{
  display:block;
  margin:var(--sm) var(--md);
  padding:var(--sm);
  border:1.5px solid var(--bdf);
  border-radius:6px;
  background:var(--s2);
  text-align:center;
  overflow:hidden;
  min-height:60px;
  font-size:0;          /* removes whitespace artefacts around inline ads */
  line-height:0;
}
.vp-sb-inline-ad > *{
  max-width:100% !important;
  font-size:13px;       /* restore for any text inside the ad */
  line-height:normal;
}
.vp-sb-inline-ad iframe,
.vp-sb-inline-ad ins,
.vp-sb-inline-ad img{
  max-width:100% !important;
  height:auto !important;
  display:inline-block !important;
}

/* === Sidebar Tags pill rule already covered by .vp-tag === */

/* === v3.4.72 — Close the empty gap above LATEST VIDEOS on home/tab pages.
   The wrap's inline padding-top:var(--lg) was creating ~24px of empty space
   before the (visually-hidden) section-hd, which the existing display:contents
   on .vp-section-hd--home-empty couldn't override because it's the WRAP's
   inline style that creates the gap, not the section-hd. Two-line fix: kill
   the wrap's top padding when --tight is present, and zero the home-bar's
   top margin/padding so it butts right up against the nav. === */
.vp-wrap--tight{padding-top:0 !important}
.vp-wrap--tight .vp-section-hd--home-empty + .vp-home-bar,
.vp-wrap--tight > .vp-home-bar{
  margin-top:0 !important;
  padding-top:0 !important;
}

/* === v3.4.73 — Category / Tag / Search gap fix.
   Same root cause as v3.4.72 (inline wrap padding + stacked margins on
   .vp-section-hd and .vp-cat-highlight) but on the archive templates.
   archive.php / search.php now use .vp-wrap--archive (no inline style);
   this block provides tight, controlled vertical rhythm on those pages. */
.vp-wrap--archive{
  padding-top:var(--sm) !important;
  padding-bottom:var(--md) !important;
}
.vp-wrap--archive > .vp-section-hd{
  margin-bottom:var(--sm) !important;
  padding-bottom:var(--xs) !important;
}
.vp-wrap--archive > .vp-cat-highlight{
  margin:0 0 var(--sm) !important;
  padding:.75rem 1rem .75rem 1.25rem !important;
}
.vp-wrap--archive > .vp-search-hd{
  margin-bottom:var(--sm) !important;
  padding-bottom:var(--xs) !important;
}
/* Pagination should sit close to the grid, not float in white space */
.vp-wrap--archive > .vp-pagi-wrap{
  padding-top:var(--sm) !important;
}
@media (max-width:768px){
  .vp-wrap--archive{
    padding-top:var(--xs) !important;
    padding-bottom:var(--sm) !important;
  }
  .vp-wrap--archive > .vp-section-hd{
    margin-bottom:var(--xs) !important;
  }
  .vp-wrap--archive > .vp-cat-highlight{
    margin:0 0 var(--xs) !important;
    padding:.6rem .85rem .6rem 1.05rem !important;
    font-size:.85rem !important;
  }
}

/* === v3.4.78 — Two-tone chips for VP taxonomies on single posts.
   Matches the sample [MODEL | SANJANA] [OTT | SLFIXHUB] [SERIES | ALOKA]
   style. Each chip is one inline link with a yellow prefix slug and a
   colored value slug, separated by a vertical bar. The color per
   taxonomy is set via class modifiers so we can tune them independently
   without touching the markup. */
.vp-vt-chip{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:stretch;
  font-family:var(--fd);
  font-weight:900;
  font-size:.6rem;
  letter-spacing:.04em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  border-radius:4px;
  overflow:hidden;
  line-height:1;
  text-decoration:none !important;
  box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  transition:transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease;
  vertical-align:middle;
  max-width:100%;
}
.vp-vt-chip:hover{
  transform:translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
}
.vp-vt-chip__pre{
  background:#facc15;
  color:#1f1500;
  padding:.32em .55em;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.vp-vt-chip__sep{
  background:#facc15;
  color:rgba(31,21,0,.45);
  padding:.32em .25em;
}
.vp-vt-chip__val{
  background:#2563eb;
  color:#fff;
  padding:.32em .65em;
  white-space:nowrap;
  overflow:hidden;
  text-overflow:ellipsis;
  max-width:14rem;
}
/* Per-taxonomy value-side colors so the three look distinct at a glance */
.vp-vt-chip--model .vp-vt-chip__val   { background:#dc2626; }
.vp-vt-chip--ott   .vp-vt-chip__val   { background:#2563eb; }
.vp-vt-chip--series .vp-vt-chip__val  { background:#7c3aed; }
/* Any user-added (vp_custom_*) taxonomy chip falls through to a neutral teal */
.vp-vt-chip[class*="vp-vt-chip--custom_"] .vp-vt-chip__val { background:#0d9488; }

html[data-theme="light"] .vp-vt-chip__pre{ background:#fde047; color:#3a2700; }
html[data-theme="light"] .vp-vt-chip__sep{ background:#fde047; color:rgba(58,39,0,.5); }

@media (max-width:480px){
  .vp-vt-chip{ font-size:.55rem; }
  .vp-vt-chip__val{ max-width:9rem; }
